name: hearthshift
description: Pilot Light Co. Hearthshift: booking, billing and compliance for shared commercial kitchens.

scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.server.json && npm run build:server && vite build
scripts.build:server: esbuild src/server/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node22 --format=esm --outfile=dist/server/main.js --external:pg-native --banner:js="import { createRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);"
